title: fix: correct BYOP device-flow guide
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Shows the absolute verification URLs returned by the device-code endpoint.
- Directs clients to share `verification_uri_complete` without adding a host.
- Condenses the device-flow use cases.

Checks: `npx biome check --write BRING_YOUR_OWN_POLLEN.md`, `git diff --check`.

Addresses #15665

gist.headline: One URL, no assembly required
gist.blurb: The BYOP device-flow guide lets verification links be themselves. Clients share the complete URL returned by the device-code endpoint—no extra host required.
gist.summary: Corrected the Bring Your Own Pollen device-flow guide to show the absolute verification URLs returned by the device-code endpoint, direct clients to share `verification_uri_complete` without adding a host, and condense the use cases.
gist.impact: Developers get a clearer device-flow example and can pass along `verification_uri_complete` as returned instead of constructing a verification link.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the BYOP device flow as a complete paper URL carried from a retro terminal to a waiting device. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, helps the eager Monitor Robot pass it along intact; small code-plants and lime-green flowers make the documentation scene feel like a cozy garden.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, a cute chunky CRT monitor robot hands over a paper link labeled `verification_uri_complete` while Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, helps guide it intact toward a waiting device among code-plants and flowers. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, and strictly pixel art. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green #ecf874, warm cream, and dark purple #110518 details.
